RecipeIngredientMention.description:
An amount-less ingredient reference (``@name`` or ``@name{}``).

Carries only an id. A mention contributes nothing to quantity and must be
backed by a declaration elsewhere in the recipe; the recipe service enforces
that invariant.

id.description: Ingredient id; must also be declared with an amount elsewhere in the recipe
id.title: Id

An ingredient declaration with an amount: ``@id{quantity%unit}`` in the
Cooklang body. Repeated declarations of one id add up.

unit.description: Measurement unit; empty string means a count (resolved to the reserved 'count' node during enrichment). Must be gram-reachable on the ingredient's catalog entry (a standard unit, a custom unit, or 'package').

RecipeYield.title: RecipeYield

description:
A parsed recipe file, ``recipes/<category>/<id>.cook``.

The file is YAML frontmatter (id, title, category, yield, storage; no
other keys) followed by a Cooklang body. Ingredients, mentions and
cookware are parsed from the body, never authored as YAML: ``@id{1/2%cup}``
declares an amount, ``@id`` or ``@id{}`` mentions an ingredient declared
elsewhere, ``#id`` names equipment, and ``~name{10%min}`` is a timer (the
name is required).

category.description: Recipe category; must equal the parent directory name

id.description: Recipe id, a lowercase kebab-case slug (alphanumeric words separated by single hyphens; trimmed and lowercased on load); must equal the file stem
id.title: Id

ingredients.description: Ingredient declarations with amounts, parsed from the body in order of appearance
ingredients.title: Ingredients

instructions.description: The Cooklang body: one step per paragraph
instructions.title: Instructions

mentions.description: Amount-less ingredient references (``@id`` or ``@id{}``) parsed from the body; each needs a declaration elsewhere
mentions.title: Mentions

yield.description: Portion count and cooked batch weight
